contentText:
There are now 24 default color options instead of 11, and you can select more via an RGB color picker. | Image: Google

Running out of color options for events in Google Calendar shouldn't be an issue going forward. The previous limit of 11 predefined colors has now been expanded to give users access to up to 200 custom colors for individual events across the native Calendar web and mobile apps, and the Calendar API.

Read the full story at The Verge.
